name: Onmyouji Heian Kaikoroku
source:
I want to be stronger than anyone! In a world under the menace of a ghost, who will you end up falling for...?

This is the Heian period. Our protagonist would rather be strong than feminine, and thus she's treated like a weirdo. However, once she meets the man everyone in palace has been talking about, her destiny will start to change!
translation:
我要比任何人都坚强！在一个充满鬼魂威胁的世界里，你最终会爱上谁……？

这是平安时代。我们的主角宁愿坚强也不愿女性化，因此她被当作怪人对待。然而，一旦她遇到了宫中人人津津乐道的男人，她的命运将开始改变！
